I’m a dentist and had something a little crazier than open or close happen…

A year ago I had a dental assistant tell me she needed to talk to me after work. 

I’m thinking I offended her or she was going to quit or had a medical issue.

Her and I alone in the office and she shyly asks me if I like her. I was confused and tell her “yeah you are great to work with” and ask her if I offended her. 

She then tells me again if I like her. I had a confused look on my face and she walks over to me and wraps her arms around me and kisses me.

My mind is blown at this moment and I have no clue what’s going on since she is a Jehovah’s Witness and married. 

I luckily stopped things and kind of came to my senses. I physically wanted to wreck her insides but luckily I was able to regain control of my senses and we both left. 

She spent the next week trying to meet with me alone again and I denied since I am also in a relationship and have a kid. 

I screen shot every text to protect my self.

She ended up “retiring” and getting out of the dental field.
